title: Matching labelings and edge assignments
statement: For natural numbers $q,k,n$, there is an equivalence between pairs consisting of a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part and a labeling of all its vertices by $	ext{Fin}(n)$ that is constant across every matched edge, and a perfect matching together with an assignment of a label in $	ext{Fin}(n)$ to each edge of that matching.
